patterns.plausible_wrong_implementation: Compose several layer-local tests that each mock an adjacent internal seam and claim the combined suite proves one real integrated path.
prevention_controls: Require one executed path crossing the public entrypoint and durable persistence with internal boundaries real.
detection_controls: Reject external-mocks-only requirements when the internal seam control mocks a non-external boundary or does not cross persistence.
sibling_cases: state transition through a later privileged action
